## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noSvelteAddEventListener`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`svelte`](/linter/domains#svelte)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`svelte/no-add-event-listener`](https://sveltejs.github.io/eslint-plugin-svelte/rules/no-add-event-listener/)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noSvelteAddEventListener": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `addEventListener` in Svelte files.

Svelte relies on event delegation for performance and to guarantee the order in which
event handlers run. Listeners attached with `addEventListener` bypass this mechanism, so
they may run before or after delegated handlers in an unexpected order. The `on`
function from `svelte/events` attaches listeners that cooperate with event delegation,
and it returns a function that removes the listener.

The rule provides a fix when `on` is already imported from `svelte/events`.

## Examples

### Invalid

```svelte
<script>
window.addEventListener("resize", handler);
</script>
```

### Valid

```svelte
<script>
import { on } from "svelte/events";

on(window, "resize", handler);
</script>
```
